attack: sweep（普通攻击，伏潭鳄王 Boss / 鳄将精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright crocodile warrior in the reference performs ONE ordinary claw sweep attack in place. From the resting pose it turns the shoulders back and draws the right clawed arm back across the body, then makes one fast strong horizontal claw sweep forward toward screen left at chest height, the jaws opening slightly, follows through, then lowers the arm and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted and the tail stays on the ground. Exactly two arms, two legs and one tail. Keep the same three-quarter left view, grey crocodile head and jaws, scaled skin, armor, belt and kilt. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No walking, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, claw trails, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: draw back over the first second, the sweep happens quickly around one and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
